detector._note: Keypoints 11-13-15 / 12-14-16 (shoulder-elbow-wrist), 3D world angle. Start with the elbow at 90 or less (TOP at <=90), press to 170-180 (BOTTOM at >=170). The END gate (hip-shoulder-wrist >= 130 at lockout) refuses a press pushed out in front instead of overhead.

stage._note: Keypoints 11-13-15 / 12-14-16 (shoulder-elbow-wrist), 3D world angle, better-seen side. Measured against the reference clip 6 Sep 2026: a locked-out press reads 142.3-146.1, never 160, for the same reason the curl never reads 170 — the forearm is edge-on and the depth axis is the noisiest. Arming at >160 counted nothing at all. >134 keeps 8 degrees of margin under the weakest lockout; <95 rests 17 degrees above the racked position. Ceiling 180: An elbow does not lock past straight. Counting happens overhead, so this refuses an impossible reading rather than a bad press. A ceiling makes the rep a whole cycle: it lands when the movement returns to rest, not when it first crosses the line, so a half rep cannot count.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, hands at shoulder height, elbows bent to 90°.
cues.tooHigh: Press all the way up — elbows locked to 170° or more overhead.
cues.tooFast: Lower the hands back to the shoulders under control.
cues.gate: Press straight up overhead, not out in front.
cues.framing: I can't see your hands — step back.
